title: Anonymous model access corrected
summary:
Anonymous model access got corrected while text routing, ad-request privacy, and image cache matching were tightened.

Unauthenticated requests now default to the anonymous tier. The tier fix restores anonymous access to `openai` and extends it to `openai-fast`, MIDIjourney, and Elixpo Search. Text requests return 402 for insufficient access and 404 for unknown models; GPT Image requires flower tier or higher.

Roblox-backed text routing gained random selection across six Azure endpoints. A subsequent tier fix restored `openai` as GPT-4.1 Mini, identified `openai-fast` as GPT-4.1 Nano, moved the Roblox model to flower-tier access, and mapped `openai-audio` to `gpt-4o-mini-audio-preview`.

Authenticated nex.ad requests no longer include the user's IP or fire impression URLs. Image semantic-cache matches now require a higher similarity score, reducing loose matches. Azure endpoint parsing also accepts `cognitiveservices.azure.com` addresses.
